newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa wins PIA Fr'furt cargo contract.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa wins PIA Fr'furt cargo contract.

text.p: Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) said it has switched its cargo handling arrangements at Frankfurt airport to Lufthansa Cargo.
Ashfaq Maher, PIA's cargo manager for Germany and Austria, said the Deutsche Lufthansa AG cargo unit took over physical handling of the airline's export and import airfreight on May 1.
PIA was previously handled by Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG), the owner and operator of Frankfurt airport, he told Reuters in an interview.
"We have no joint venture with Lufthansa Cargo but we work very closely with them. We believe we are better with Lufthansa than with FAG," he said.
The airline would now be able to offer freight forwarders faster delivery times and shorter transfer times, he added.
PIA will continue to be responsible for the documentation of its air cargo at Frankfurt, Maher said.
Between Pakistan and Germany, PIA operates three weekly Boeing 707 freighter flights, twice-weekly 747 Combi services and a weekly passenger flight with an Airbus A310 aircraft.
